opening.argument: The speaker actively promotes Yieldnodes and Strong Nodes as passive-income opportunities, calling them “two of my favorite passive income platforms” that have “really changed my life.” He associates Yieldnodes with about 10% monthly returns and Strong Nodes with roughly 20–30% monthly returns, even estimating 300–400% annually—unusually high recurring figures for paid node programs. This is not neutral discussion: viewers are told to check out both platforms, and interested viewers are directed to a referral link. The presentation reinforces participation through favorable claims that these are great, highly profitable opportunities rather than scams, while soliciting viewers through links.
